meta.title: Speak Up Clinic — Neurodevelopment clinic in Tirana
meta.description: A neurodevelopment and speech therapy clinic in Tirana. Detailed assessment and therapy for children, adults and older people. Six years of experience, more than 500 cases treated.

hero_p: Dedicated to helping you towards a better future. Assessment, therapy and support for children, adults and older people.
toy_p: Pick a sound and get this week's word with the tip we give parents. These are the same drills we use in the room.

sounds.tip: Tongue tip behind the upper teeth, let the air buzz. Start with a car's “brr”, not the whole word.
Teeth together, lips in a smile, a thin snake-like stream of air. If the tongue pokes out, use a straw.
Lips rounded like a kiss, tongue up. Say “shsh” together, as if hushing a baby.
Tongue tip touches the ridge behind the teeth and stays there. Stretch it: “llll-ule”.
This one is born at the back of the throat. Try it with the head tilted back a little, like a small cough.

what_h2: What we do in the room
what_p: No worksheets. It all happens through games, a mirror, and toys the child picks out.

cards.title: Games with sounds
cards.desc: We hide cards, roll dice, build towers — and every move asks for one accurate sound.

cards.title: The big mirror
cards.desc: The child watches their own tongue and lips and sees why the sound isn't coming. That's half the work.

cards.title: One small home task
cards.desc: You leave with a single game for the week. Ten minutes a day, no more.

chart_p: Every session earns a star. Ten stars make a certificate with your child's name — and a photo on the clinic wall, if the parent is happy with that.

privacy.title: How we use your details
privacy.description: What Speak Up collects when you book or write to us, why, who sees it, and how to ask us to delete it.
privacy.lede: When you book or write to us, you trust us with details about yourself and your child. This page explains what we collect, why, who sees it, and how to ask us to delete it.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Your details are handled by {clinic}, in Tirana. For any question about them, contact us at the details at the end of this page.

sections.title: What we collect
body: Only what you give us yourself through the forms on this site:
items: When you book: the service, day and time you choose, your name, phone and email, and — if you fill them in — your child's age and your notes.
When you write to us from the contact page: your name, phone, email if you give one, your child's age, the topic and your message.
The IP address the form was sent from, to protect against spam.

sections.title: Information about your child's health
body: Notes and messages may include information about your child's speech, development or health. We treat it as sensitive: only the clinic's staff read it, and it is used only to prepare for the appointment.
Write only what you would like us to know before the appointment. Everything else we can talk about in person.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To arrange and confirm the appointment you ask for, to reply to you, and to email you a copy of your booking and any change to it. We do not use it for advertising and we do not sell it to anyone.
We use it with your consent, which you give by ticking the box on the form. You can withdraw it at any time by contacting us.

sections.title: Who else handles it
body: Inside the clinic, only the staff who deal with bookings and therapy. Outside it, only the technical services the site cannot work without:
items: DigitalOcean — the server where bookings and messages are stored, in Frankfurt (Germany).
Cloudflare — the network the site is served through, which also protects it from attacks.
Postmark — the service that sends booking emails. It is based in the USA, so your name, email and booking details pass through it there to be delivered.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: For as long as we need it to provide the service and to meet the clinic's legal obligations. After that we delete it. You can ask us to delete it sooner, at any time.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This site uses no cookies and does not track you: there are no analytics, no advertising and no outside services following your visits.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask us at any time to:
items: see what details we hold about you and your child;
correct them if they are wrong;
delete them;
withdraw the consent you gave.

sections.title: If you are not happy
body: Please write to us first, and we will sort it out together. You also have the right to complain to Albania's Information and Data Protection Commissioner (idp.al).

services.title: What you will find with us

tabs.heading: At Speak Up Clinic you will find every kind of intervention therapy
tabs.body: We are always looking to give the very best to every child. Our pathologists specialise in:

tabs.heading: A detailed assessment and plan for every patient
tabs.body: We offer a detailed one-week assessment for every client who comes to Speak Up Clinic. It is carried out by a range of specialists, and the results are gathered and worked up into an individual report.

tabs.heading: Support for the parent or carer
tabs.body: Support for parents begins with a child-centred care plan aimed at your child's own challenges and goals. Our therapists can help your family to:
list: learn strategies that strengthen your child's communication and social development
feel more confident using specialist advice to respond in different urgent situations

tabs.heading: A detailed assessment and plan for every patient
tabs.body: We offer a detailed one-week assessment for every client who comes to Speak Up Clinic. It is carried out by a range of specialists, and the results are gathered and worked up into an individual report.

tabs.heading: Our pathologists treat
tabs.body: There are many reasons why you might have difficulty with speech or language. Some begin in childhood. Others follow an illness or an injury. Speech and language pathologists can help.

tabs.heading: It is never too late to get the help you need
tabs.body: Speech therapy can help people of any age. If you are wondering whether it is too late to improve your communication through speech therapy — it is not. With our support and your family's, we can reach results you will be happy with.

services.allAges: The Neurodevelopment Clinic treats people of every age — paediatric, adult and geriatric — who need support with their communication.

therapies.title: What we offer
therapies.lede: At Speak Up Clinic you will find the main intervention therapies used worldwide. We work continuously to offer the best possible service to as many patients as we can.

items.name: Speech and language therapy
points: Helps anyone with difficulties in speech, language or communication, at any age and with any diagnosis.

items.name: Developmental therapy
points: Used in cases of intellectual disability.
Helps build the skills and competencies behind a person's independence.

items.name: Oro-myo-facial therapy
points: Used where the muscles of the face and mouth have been affected.

items.name: Chewing and swallowing therapy
points: Training the muscles to work together, for patients who have difficulty with feeding.

items.name: ABA therapy
points: The most widely used approach in autism spectrum disorder.
Staff qualified in ABA and in the other therapies combined with it for this diagnosis.

items.name: Behavioural therapy
points: Helps teach and strengthen positive behaviours, and reduce unwanted or difficult ones.

about.title: Our work began in August 2019
intro: The Speak Up Neurodevelopment Clinic has been working since August 2019. In the months that followed, more than 500 cases have been treated, and many consultations and assessments carried out with paediatric, adult and geriatric patients.
At Speak Up Clinic it is our aim to help our patients meet their communication goals, by offering comprehensive assessments and treatment across every diagnosis.
Qualified staff, trained both in Albania and abroad in speech and language therapy and neurodevelopmental disorders, contribute at this clinic to reach the best possible potential for every patient.
We also believe in empowering parents and carers through collaboration and training — letting families take ownership of the results of therapy.
about.journeyLede: With six years of experience behind us, Speak Up Clinic has treated more than 500 cases across a wide range of diagnoses. Our mission remains to help our clients meet their communication goals, through comprehensive assessment and committed treatment.
more: The clinical specialists working at Speak Up Clinic diagnose and treat every kind of communication difficulty — including speech delay, stammering, articulation, expressive language, receptive language, social communication and accent modification — at every age from paediatric to adult.
Every patient who comes to our clinic receives a specific assessment and a detailed intervention plan, which the therapists follow continuously, working carefully through every goal in the programme.

The type of therapy a patient needs is determined by the detailed one-week assessment at our centre. After ongoing testing, the intervention plan is set, along with the combination of therapies each case requires.
Our ABA therapists deliver this therapy for every child diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder.
